body.name: Open contact-set excursion program
body.construction: The declustering handle is the unresolved program that starts from the fixed-location field \(D\) and contact diagnostic \(R_{\mathrm c}\) and seeks: an infinite-domain contact-set large-deviation principle; action-minimizer classification modulo translation; a sharp Palm Laplace expansion with multiplicity and conditional cluster-shape control; short-range anticlustering; marked-Poisson approximation; and a sample-path modulus and grid theorem. The handle names proof obligations and does not assert that a cluster intensity or limit law exists.
